user.title: Connect to OdoDash
user.description: Paste the server address and Home Assistant key from OdoDash: Settings → Integrations → Home Assistant.

data_description.url: The address Home Assistant can reach OdoDash on, for example http://192.168.1.10:5050
data_description.api_key: Starts with odoha_. Older account API keys (odo_) also work.
data_description.verify_ssl: Turn off only for a self-signed certificate.

reauth_confirm.title: New OdoDash key needed
reauth_confirm.description: OdoDash at {url} no longer accepts the saved key. Create a new Home Assistant key in OdoDash and paste it here.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot reach OdoDash at that address.
error.invalid_auth: OdoDash rejected the key. Regenerate it in OdoDash and try again.
error.invalid_url: That is not a valid address.

abort.already_configured: This OdoDash account is already set up.
abort.wrong_account: That key belongs to a different OdoDash account.

data_description.scan_interval: OdoDash data only changes when you log something, so 15 minutes is plenty. Minimum 5.

not_a_vehicle.message: Pick an OdoDash vehicle, not the OdoDash account device.

not_loaded.message: That vehicle's OdoDash connection is not loaded.

add_fuel_failed.message: OdoDash did not save the fill-up: {error}

device_id.name: Vehicle
device_id.description: The OdoDash vehicle to log against.

volume.name: Volume
volume.description: Fuel added, in your OdoDash volume unit.

total_cost.name: Total cost
total_cost.description: Leave empty to use volume × price per unit.

is_full_tank.name: Full tank
is_full_tank.description: Whether the tank was filled up.

notes.name: Notes
notes.description: Optional note saved with the fill-up.
